arguments.rationale: TENT-284 satisfies all requirements: $84 price within $100 budget, quality score 4.6 exceeds 4.0 minimum via independent certificate from independent_outdoor_lab (platform-held record), and verified by two matching purchase ledger reviews in the immutable review_registry (REV-G1: 4.6, REV-G2: 4.4). Evidence sources are suitable and scope supports decision. TENT-731 lacks independent quality certificate and its only review scores 2.0, below the 4.0 quality mandate.
